source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Marisol, I hope you’re doing well. We’ve received the client’s electrical notes: the stamped note was good, and the drawings were fine except that certain items needed to be called out. I’ve included the client’s request along with the information from the electrician. Since these callouts are part of the original scope and merely present it in greater detail, could you please stamp them? Thank you.

value_updates.required_action: apply the electrical PE stamp to the identified callouts
value_updates.content_scope: original-scope electrical changes presented in greater detail

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: I appreciate your revision, but this requires additional stamps and was not part of our initial scope, as you know.

ambiguity.description: The freelancer disputes whether stamping the additional callouts is included in the original agreed scope.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Marisol, thank you for responding. These callouts contain the same material you stamped in the letter; the only change is that content formerly presented as written annotations now appears on schematic sheets. You can verify the match because each callout heading in your letter corresponds to the description shown in the schematic.

Please reconsider and stamp these original-scope callouts in a schematic layout. This work belongs to the second milestone for addressing the city’s and client’s comments.

Thank you in advance for your support.
